review_batches.context: All 292 rows read. After Lyle's battle, Forzen reports who is with Ymir in two alternatives. Touya/Kasumi affirm her adoptive family; discussion shifts to Valga's hypothesis about Rayblade's Core and renewed Vorlia summoning. Celica explains the excavated power-source material; Valga warns of strain on Goderius and Rishuna's recovery.
review_batches.decisions: Keep alternatives with/without Leone separate, family-care direction and Forzen's self-doubt versus Touya's reassurance. Preserve blackmail/abduction accusation as spoken. Core as substance is distinct from named Core mechs/Brain Core; Celica says they cannot synthesize it, without real scientific claims or a numerical scarcity. Valga/Celica's enemy-plan explanation remains inference where marked. Rishuna's expected recovery is Valga's view. Silences, laughter, farewells and incomplete reactions are deliberate; significant omissions are noted below.
